name: Massive
description: Massive lets agents read stock, options, forex, and crypto market data, such as prices, aggregates, and company details, with the signed-in Massive account. Each user signs in to their own Massive account through the browser.

prompts.text: Show the daily closing prices of AAPL for the last month.
Compare the year-to-date returns of SPY, QQQ, and IWM.
What are the current price and 24-hour volume of Bitcoin?

apps.name: Massive
apps.description: Stock, options, forex, and crypto market data, over Massive's MCP server with browser sign-in.
